turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (NURSE): Meera Sharma, blood pressure is one eighteen over seventy-six, pulse eighty-eight, and temperature is thirty-seven point one. The urine bottle is outside if it is needed. Please go in.
[SEG0002] person_2 (DOCTOR): Sit. What brings you today?

[SEG0003] person_3 (PATIENT): Doctor, the burning has started again when I pass urine. So uncomfortable. We were at my cousin Ritu's engagement in Gurgaon on Saturday, and I missed the rasmalai because I was stuck in the ladies' queue, and the DJ was deafening.
[SEG0004] person_2 (DOCTOR): Since when?
[SEG0005] person_3 (PATIENT): Sunday night, so day before yesterday. Mild only then. From yesterday the burning is strong, mainly at the end.
[SEG0006] person_2 (DOCTOR): How many times this year?
[SEG0007] person_3 (PATIENT): This is the third time this year. Wait, actually maybe the fourth. January also, after the Jaipur trip. I mix them up.
[SEG0008] person_2 (DOCTOR): Fever?
[SEG0009] person_3 (PATIENT): The real problem is office, doctor. Accounts department, meetings all day, my water bottle just sits there. My mother-in-law already shouted on the phone this morning.
[SEG0010] person_2 (DOCTOR): I am asking about fever. Yes or no?
[SEG0011] person_3 (PATIENT): No fever.
[SEG0012] person_2 (DOCTOR): Passing urine more often?
[SEG0013] person_3 (PATIENT): Every half an hour, small quantity only. I got up three times at night also.
[SEG0014] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any blood?
[SEG0015] person_3 (PATIENT): No blood that I saw.
[SEG0016] person_2 (DOCTOR): Pain in the abdomen or the back?
[SEG0017] person_3 (PATIENT): A little heaviness low down in front. Back is completely okay.
[SEG0018] person_2 (DOCTOR): Vaginal discharge or itching?
[SEG0019] person_3 (PATIENT): No, nothing like that. I don't have those problems.
[SEG0020] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): You told me last night about the itching, Meera.
[SEG0021] person_3 (PATIENT): Mummy, softly, please. Okay, since yesterday there is some itching, and this morning a little white discharge, very slight. I was just embarrassed.
[SEG0022] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any bad smell?
[SEG0023] person_3 (PATIENT): No bad smell.
[SEG0024] person_2 (DOCTOR): What medicines did you take?
[SEG0025] person_3 (PATIENT): My sister Priya's leftover antibiotic, two tablets. I think it was Cifran five hundred, one yesterday morning and one at night. Then the strip was empty.
[SEG0026] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): I had told her, do not finish Priya's tablets. Priya had her own urine infection last month.
[SEG0027] person_2 (DOCTOR): Stopped after those two?
[SEG0028] person_3 (PATIENT): Yes, stopped. Nothing remaining.
[SEG0029] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any other tablet?

[SEG0030] person_3 (PATIENT): One Crocin five hundred last night, for the heaviness. My neighbour also said jeera water is good, so I made some. The whole flat smelled of cumin. That is not a tablet, though.
[SEG0031] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any drug allergy?
[SEG0032] person_3 (PATIENT): No allergies at all.
[SEG0033] person_2 (DOCTOR): Diabetes? Kidney stones?
[SEG0034] person_3 (PATIENT): No and no. They called it urine infection in January, again in March, and I think once in June. So yes, maybe the fourth now.
[SEG0035] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Her father has diabetes, on tablets for years. Shouldn't you check her sugar?
[SEG0036] person_2 (DOCTOR): Not today. Pregnant? When did the period start?
[SEG0037] person_3 (PATIENT): Not pregnant. It started on the second, four days, normal. I am thirty-two.

[SEG0038] person_2 (DOCTOR): On pressing, there is mild tenderness just above the pubic bone. No tenderness in either loin. This is most likely a urine infection again. I cannot rule out a mild vaginal infection as well.

[SEG0039] person_2 (DOCTOR): I am ordering a urine routine and a urine culture now. Do not take any more of someone else's antibiotic, and drink plenty of water. Come back in three days with the report. If you develop fever or see blood, come the same day.
